resolved_blockers.issue: The initial terminal-HFSS classifier admitted blank or non-string error values and contradictory raw error records carrying success or skip fields.
resolved_blockers.resolution: The frozen implementation requires a nonblank string error, exact allowed error/skip fields, an integer non-boolean attempts value of at least three, and rejects raw or explicit-skipped hybrids before any normalization write.

resolved_blockers.issue: The initial startup normalizer treated malformed and non-HFSS raw errors as pending, allowing them to reach todo construction and potentially open HFSS before strict end validation.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Every raw error must now pass the same strict HFSS classifier at terminal_attempts=1 before retry. Known HFSS attempts 1 or 2 remain pending; malformed attempts, non-HFSS kinds, contradictory fields, and invalid schemas fail before a normalization write or simulator construction.

resolved_blockers.issue: The final dedust diagnostic could describe a hard non-HFSS error with attempts >= 3 as ignored immediately before strict verification rejected it.
resolved_blockers.resolution: In scoped skip mode, the diagnostic poison list now includes only entries whose persisted status is skipped. Persisted state and control flow are unchanged.

validated_semantics: Only known terminal HFSS simulation failures with attempts >= 3 become status=skipped and skip_reason=hfss_attempts_exhausted; profile, manifest, hash, schema, and data-integrity failures remain hard failures.

Normalization preserves the original error, error_kind, and attempts evidence and occurs before scoped todo construction and before opening the simulator, so legacy terminal poison is not retried on another host.

Execution completion is an exact manifest partition of ok plus skipped observations. Strict verify_completed(require_complete=true) remains success-only for truth, engineering/formal merge, and training paths.

Skipped rows are excluded from successful observation counts and training inputs. A scoped worker writes a normal done receipt with nonzero errors and the complete canonical skipped-id list, continues to later jobs, and returns success for once-mode after terminal skip completion.

R81 queue validation checks skipped ids against the done receipt, remains active while any other job is active, and emits terminal_skips only when the queue has settled without a hard failure. Formal aggregation still rejects skipped shards, preventing false promotion or training.
A one-row all-poison scoped job terminates as skipped without reopening HFSS. Simulator-open failures and existing machine-wide failure/blowout fuses remain hard safeguards.
Malformed or non-HFSS raw errors fail during startup normalization before todo construction can open HFSS; valid known HFSS failures with attempts 1 or 2 remain retryable pending rows.
The scoped poison diagnostic reports ignored only for persisted skipped entries.
nonblocking_observations: An all-skipped small job is intentionally terminal even though repeated per-row HFSS failure cannot by itself distinguish toxic geometry from a persistent sample-specific simulator fault. The preserved evidence and unchanged simulator-open and aggregate-failure fuses provide the retained diagnostic boundary.
